prepared.title: Planning the Spring Glaze Workshop
prepared.text:
Not for what you include. Compare the classes item by item:

| Included | Other studio, $160 | Your workshop, $195 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Four evenings | Yes | Yes |
| Clay | Yes | Yes |
| Bisque firing | Yes | Yes |
| Glaze firing | No, extra | Yes |
| Glaze lesson and test tiles | No | Yes |
| Class size | Not stated | 8 at most |

If their glaze firing costs about $10 a piece, two pieces bring their class to about $180 without a glaze lesson. Say plainly in your description that both firings and the glazes are included. Then the $15 difference reads as a smaller class and a lesson, not as a higher price.
